name: std-learn-compare
description: Generic dual-view comparator — two instances of the same config-declared curve family (power y = A·xᴮ, linear y = A + B·x, or sine y = A·sin(B·x)) render overlaid on one canvas, each side driven by its own parameter pair of sliders, with a live delta readout of the two values at the midpoint x. Changing either side recomputes immediately, so the learner sees exactly how the two settings diverge. All labels and defaults are config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any side-by-side contrast: two interest rates compounding, two spring constants, two demand elasticities, two wave frequencies. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

orbital CompareOrbital {
  type CompareCurve = {
    label : string
    color : string
    samples : [CompareCurveSample]!
  }
  type CompareCurveSample = {
    x : number!
    y : number!

    id : string!
    active : boolean = false
    title : string
    curveKind : string
    leftA : number = 0
    leftB : number = 0
    rightA : number = 0
    rightB : number = 0

    xMid : number = 0
    leftMid : number = 0
    rightMid : number = 0
    delta : number = 0
    yMin : number
    yMax : number

    initial: idle

    state idle {
      INIT -> idle when (== @config.matchMode "")
        (let (
            (kind @config.curveKind)
            (span (- @config.xMax @config.xMin))
            (lA @config.leftADefault)
            (lB @config.leftBDefault)
            (rA @config.rightADefault)
            (rB @config.rightBDefault)
            (leftSamples (array/map (array/range 0 81) (fn (i)
              (let (
                  (x (+ @config.xMin (* @i (/ @span 80))))
                  (yVal (if (== @kind "power")
                          (* @lA (math/pow @x @lB))
                          (if (== @kind "linear")
                            (+ @lA (* @lB @x))
                            (* @lA (math/sin (* @lB @x))))))
                )
                { x: @x, y: @yVal }))))
            (rightSamples (array/map (array/range 0 81) (fn (i)
              (let (
                  (x (+ @config.xMin (* @i (/ @span 80))))
                  (yVal (if (== @kind "power")
                          (* @rA (math/pow @x @rB))
                          (if (== @kind "linear")
                            (+ @rA (* @rB @x))
                            (* @rA (math/sin (* @rB @x))))))
                )
                { x: @x, y: @yVal }))))
            (allSamples (array/concat @leftSamples @rightSamples))
            (yMinRaw (array/reduce @allSamples (object/get (array/nth @allSamples 0) y) (fn (acc s) (math/min @acc (object/get @s y)))))
            (yMaxRaw (array/reduce @allSamples (object/get (array/nth @allSamples 0) y) (fn (acc s) (math/max @acc (object/get @s y)))))
            (yPad (* 0.1 (math/max 0.001 (- @yMaxRaw @yMinRaw))))
            (xMidV (/ (+ @config.xMin @config.xMax) 2))
            (lMid (if (== @kind "power") (* @lA (math/pow @xMidV @lB)) (if (== @kind "linear") (+ @lA (* @lB @xMidV)) (* @lA (math/sin (* @lB @xMidV))))))
            (rMid (if (== @kind "power") (* @rA (math/pow @xMidV @rB)) (if (== @kind "linear") (+ @rA (* @rB @xMidV)) (* @rA (math/sin (* @rB @xMidV))))))
          )
          (do
            (set @entity.active true)
            (set @entity.title @config.title)
            (set @entity.curveKind @kind)
            (set @entity.leftA @lA)
            (set @entity.leftB @lB)
            (set @entity.rightA @rA)
            (set @entity.rightB @rB)
            (set @entity.xMid @xMidV)
            (set @entity.leftMid @lMid)
            (set @entity.rightMid @rMid)
            (set @entity.delta (- @rMid @lMid))
            (set @entity.yMin (- @yMinRaw @yPad))

            ])))

          type: box

          )

            (set @entity.leftA @lA)

            (set @entity.curves [

        (render-ui main {
